propositions: A configured provider is silently discarded when the model id contains a colon (as in canonical Bedrock versioned ids like 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'), because _resolve_target incorrectly interprets any colon as a provider separator.
The qualified/unqualified decision is made by two independent colon scans in _resolve_target and infer_provider, which can drift apart and produce inconsistent results.
An explicitly configured provider should be honored first before scanning the model string for a qualifier, so that no punctuation in the model id can overrule or discard an explicit instruction.

A conflicting pair of configured provider and inline qualifier (e.g., provider='bedrock' with model starting 'openai:') should raise LLMConfigError rather than silently selecting one and discarding the other.
The unversioned Bedrock alias form (e.g., 'us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6') happens to work because it contains no colon, masking the bug for that model class shape.
